title: hieracium sylvaticum
intro: Hieracium sylvaticum, commonly known as Wood Hawkweed or Hawkweed, is a flowering plant belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, inflammation, and skin conditions, such as eczema and acne, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium sylvaticum include soothing irritations, reducing swelling, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
